sources.title: Chinook416/caracat_code · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Caracat Code is an AI coding model based on Qwen3-Coder-Next by Qwen. Status: pre-release. No fine-tuning has been performed yet, and no weights are published in this repository. This model card documents the project, its base model and its licensing. It is updated when that changes — it does not describe capabilities the model does not yet have.
